PS49: The outgoing, wandering soul, upon meeting the True Guru, opens the Tenth Gate.
The outgoing soul becomes steady by meeting the True Guru and enters into the Tenth gate.
8AYL: There, Ambrosial Nectar is food and the celestial music resounds; the world is held spell-bound by the music of the Word.
There, ambrosia is man's food and resounds there the celestial strain, with which music the world is sustained.
4JZ2: The many strains of the unstruck melody resound there, as one merges in Truth.
Many musical instruments and unstruck music ever resounds there and the mortal remains absorbed in the True Lord.
9W5D: Thus says Nanak: by meeting the True Guru, the wandering soul becomes steady, and comes to dwell in the home of its own self. ||4||
Thus says Nanak, by meeting the True Guru, the wandering mind becomes steady and comes and dwells within its own home.
9H5T: O my mind, you are the embodiment of the Divine Light - recognize your own origin.
My soul, you are the embodiment (image) of Divine light, so know your source.
B78M: O my mind, the Dear Lord is with you; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.
O my soul, the reverend Lord is with you. By Guru's teaching enjoy His love.
C759: Acknowledge your origin, and then you shall know your Husband Lord, and so understand death and birth.
If you recognise your origin, then shall you know your Spouse and understand the secret of death and birth.
AYE5: By Guru's Grace, know the One; then, you shall not love any other.
If by Guru's grace the One Lord, then you shall lose the love of another.
VW9B: Peace comes to the mind, and gladness resounds; then, you shall be acclaimed.
If in your mind comes peace and gladness resounds, then alone you shall be approved.
XYJ9: Thus says Nanak: O my mind, you are the very image of the Luminous Lord; recognize the true origin of your self. ||5||
Thus say Nanak, O my soul, you are the image of the Luminous Lord. Realise you the true origin of your being.
R2Z3: O mind, you are so full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart.
O man, you are full of with pride and laden with pride and you shall depart.
0LA1: The fascinating Maya has fascinated you, over and over again, and lured you into reincarnation.
Fascinating mammon has fascinated you and again and you shall be goaded into existences.
K7TK: Clinging to pride, you shall depart, O foolish mind, and in the end, you shall regret and repent.
clinging to pride you goest, O foolish man, and while departing, you shall repent in the end.
3EK7: You are afflicted with the diseases of ego and desire, and you are wasting your life away in vain.
With the ailment of ego and again you are afflicted and are vainly devastating (wasting) your life.
EJMJ: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord, and shall regret and repent hereafter.
The self-willed fool remembers not the Lord and repent while going yonder (in the next world).
0MDU: Thus says Nanak: O mind, you are full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart. ||6||
Thus says Nanak, O man! you are filled with pride, and laden with pride you shall depart.
VT56: O mind, don't be so proud of yourself, as if you know it all; the Gurmukh is humble and modest.
O man, take not pride that you knowest some thing but be you pious and humble.
46ET: Within the intellect are ignorance and ego; through the True Word of the Shabad, this filth is washed off.
Within you are ignorance and pride of intellect. By the true word wash off this filth.
56WF: So be humble, and surrender to the True Guru; do not attach your identity to your ego.
Be humble before the True Guru and show not your ownself.
2PYZ: The world is consumed by ego and self-identity; see this, lest you lose your own self as well.
By its own pride the world is burning. Allow not yourself to be ruined like wise.
W6SU: Make yourself follow the Sweet Will of the True Guru; remain attached to His Sweet Will.
Attend to your business according to the will of the true Guru and remain attached to the will of the true Guru.
JH8Z: Thus says Nanak: renounce your ego and self-conceit, and obtain peace; let your mind abide in humility. ||7||
Thus say Nanak, forsake you your self conceit and continue to be meek, O man. Thus shall you obtain happiness.
G7K3: Blessed is that time, when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness.
Blest is the time when I met the true Guru and remembered God, the spouse.
7QPA: I became so very blissful, and my mind and body found such a natural peace.
I naturally got exceedingly delighted and obtain the peace of mind and body.
V7ZF: My Husband Lord came into my consciousness; I enshrined Him within my mind, and I renounced all vice.
I remembered the Bridegroom, enshrined Him within my mind and forsook all the evils.
PK7M: When it pleased Him, virtues appeared in me, and the True Guru Himself adorned me.
When it pleased Him, virtues became manifest in me and the Guru himself bedecked me.
UHAN: Those humble beings become acceptable, who cling to the One Name and renounce the love of duality.
The persons, who cling to One Name and renounce another's love, become acceptable.
3GUJ: Thus says Nanak: blessed is the time when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness. ||8||
Thus says Nanak, blessed is the time when I met the True Guru and remembered that groom of mine.
VJWX: Some people wander around, deluded by doubt; their Husband Lord Himself has misled them.
Some people are gone astray in doubt but them the Spouse Himself has strayed.
B6UJ: They wander around in the love of duality, and they do their deeds in ego.
They wander about in another's love and go about their business in pride.
PHP5: Their Husband Lord Himself has misled them, and put them on the path of evil. Nothing lies in their power.
Them, the Lord has Himself misled and put them on the evil track. Nothing lies in their power.
2GRG: You alone know their ups and downs, You, who created the creation.
Their ascent and decent, you alone knowest, you, who have created the creation.
TFDC: The Command of Your Will is very strict; how rare is the Gurmukh who understands.
Exceedingly strict is yours command to act upon but through the Guru, hardly one realises it.
JBR5: Thus says Nanak: what can the poor creatures do, when You mislead them into doubt? ||9||
Thus says Nanak, what can be poor creatures do, when you misleadest them into doubt?

MKVR: O My True Lord Master, True is Your glorious greatness.
My true Lord, true is Yours greatness.
K2A7: You are the Supreme Lord God, the Infinite Lord and Master. Your creative power cannot be described.
You are the Transcendent Lord and the Infinite Master. Your might cannot be described.
XV4X: True is Your glorious greatness; when You enshrine it within the mind, one sings Your Glorious Praises forever.
True is your grandeur, and he within whose mind, you enshrines it, ever sings Yours praises.
TGQ0: He sings Your Glorious Praises, when it is pleasing to You, O True Lord; he centers his consciousness on You.
When the mortal becomes pleasing to You, he sings Your glory and fixes his attention on You, O True Lord.
PG72: One whom You unite with Yourself, as Gurmukh, remains absorbed in You.
Whom you unitest with yourself he by Guru's grace, remains absorbed in you.
9MKY: Thus says Nanak: O my True Lord Master, True is Your Glorious Greatness. ||10||2||7||5||2||7||
Thus says Nanak O my true Lord, true is Yours glory.
LHYE: Raag Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House:
EP0F: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace He is obtained.
15QR: Life - I have found real life, as Gurmukh, through His Love.
Life, the real life, I have obtained through love of the Exalted Guru.
39D7: The Lord's Name - He has given me the Lord's Name, and enshrined it within my breath of life.
God's Name, God's Name, the Guru has given me, and has enshrined it in my mind.
200B: He has enshrined the Name of the Lord, Har, Har within my breath of lfe, and all my doubts and sorrows have departed.
The Lord God's Name, he has placed within my mind, and all my doubts and troubles have departed.
D1UH: I have meditated on the invisible and unapproachable Lord, through the Guru's Word, and I have obtained the pure, supreme status.
By Guru's word, I have meditated on the Invisible and Inapprehensible Lord and have obtained the pure supreme status.
BJCS: The unstruck melody resounds, and the instruments ever vibrate, singing the Bani of the True Guru.
On singing the hymns of the True Guru, the musical instruments ever play and the unstruck music resounds.
SE9A: O Nanak, God the Great Giver has given me a gift; He has blended my light into the Light. ||1||
Nanak the Giver Lord has given me a gift and my light has blended with His supreme Light.
PUQJ: The self-willed manmukhs die in their self-willed stubbornness, declaring that the wealth of Maya is theirs.
The perverse die in their perversity, proclaiming wealth as their own.
U4S5: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which comes for a moment, and departs in an instant.
They attach their mind to the nasty-smelling mound, which comes for a moment and in a moment departs.
YRPD: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which is transitory, like the fading color of the safflower.
They attach and fix their mind on the heap of bad odour, which is seen fleeting like the colour of saf-flower.
J8PS: One moment, they are facing east, and the next instant, they are facing west; they continue spinning around, like the potter's wheel.
In an instant they go to the east, and in a instant to the west. They continue revolving like the potter's wheel.
FSNL: In sorrow, they eat, and in sorrow, they gather things and try to enjoy them, but they only increase their stores of sorrow.
In pain they eat, in pain they amass and enjoy. They increase their store of sorrow.
K10B: O Nanak, one easily crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, when he comes to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||
Nanak, when man enters the Guru's Sanctuary, he easily crosses the arduous ocean.
F3S1: My Lord, my Lord Master is sublime, unapproachable and unfathomable.
The Lord, my Lord is sublime unapproachable and unfathomable.
8DAT: The wealth of the Lord - I seek the wealth of the Lord, from my True Guru, the Divine Banker.
God's capital, God's capital I desire from my True Guru, the banker.
6K3U: I seek the wealth of the Lord, to purchase the Naam; I sing and love the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
I long for God's wealth to buy the Name. I sing God's praises and God's praise do I love.
C57T: I have totally renounced sleep and hunger, and through deep meditation, I am absorbed into the Absolute Lord.
Sleep and hunger I have all cast and shaken off and through profound concentration. I am absorbed in the Absolute Lord.
GN1S: The traders of one kind come and take away the Name of the Lord as their profit.
The dealers of one king come and take away God's Name as their profit.
X34C: O Nanak, dedicate your mind and body to the Guru; one who is so destined, attains it. ||3||
Nanak, dedicate your soul and body to the Guru. He who is destined to attain, attains God's Name.
VQ1J: The great ocean is full of the treasures of jewels upon jewels.
The great ocean is full of the wealth of jewels, upon jewels.
0NC3: Those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani, see them come into their hands.
They who are attached with Divine word, the Gurbani, obtain it.
7S6Y: This priceless, incomparable jewel comes into the hands of those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani.
They (this wealth) who are attached with the Guru's hymns, obtain the invaluable, unrivalled jewel.
MSHA: They obtain the immeasurable Name of the Lord, Har, Har; their treasure is overflowing with devotional worship.
They who obtain Your immeasurable Name, O Lord God, have their treasure brimful with Your devotional service.
3EP1: I have churned the ocean of the body, and I have seen the incomparable thing come into view.
I have churned the body ocean and I have seen an enamourning thing come to view.
PD2J: The Guru is God, and God is the Guru, O Nanak; there is no difference between the two, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||1||8||
The Guru is God and God is the Guru, O Nanak. There is no difference between the two, my brother.
4EBD: Slowly, slowly, slowly, very slowly, the drops of Ambrosial Nectar trickle down.
Slowly, steadily and slowly and steadily trickles (pours down) the Nectar fall.

8NYR: As Gurmukh, the Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Beloved Lord.
Through the Guru the Guru-ward beholds the Beloved Omnipresent Lord Master.
76L5: The Name of the Lord, the Emancipator of the world, is dear to him; the Name of the Lord is his glory.
God's Name, the World emancipator is dear to him in the God's Name alone is the glory.
GCUC: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the boat, which carries the Gurmukh across.
In the Dark age, Lord's Name is the ship and through the Guru the man swims across.
HVGG: This world, and the world hereafter, are adorned with the Lord's Name; the Gurmukh's lifestyle is the most excellent.
This world and the world beyond get adorned with Lord's Name. The Guru's ward's way of life is sublime.
RDAY: O Nanak, bestowing His kindness, the Lord gives the gift of His emancipating Name. ||1||
Nanak, showering His benediction, God gives the gift of His emancipating Name.
FD66: I chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, which destroys my sorrows and erases my sins.
The Lord Master's Name, I have repeated and it has destroyed and dispelled my sorrow and sin, O Lord.
YT78: Associating with the Guru, associating with the Guru, I practice meditation; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart.
By Guru's association, Guru's association, I have remembered the Lord Master, and have enshrined Him in my mind.
48RP: I enshrined the Lord within my heart, and obtained the supreme status, when I came to the Sanctuary of the Guru.
When I sought the Guru's protection, Lord's Name got established in my mind and I obtained the supreme rank.
Z1Y3: My boat was sinking under the weight of greed and corruption, but it was uplifted when the True Guru implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.
When the True Guru Implanted God's Name within me, my sinking boat, laden with avarice, and sin, safely emerged out.
Z4TY: The Perfect Guru has given me the gift of spiritual life, and I center my consciousness on the Lord's Name.
The perfect Guru has given me the gift of spiritual life and I have fixed my attention on Lord's Name.
J05B: The Merciful Lord Himself has mercifully given this gift to me; O Nanak, I take to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||
O Nanak, the merciful Master Himself mercifully gives the Name to him, who seeks the Guru's protection.
PRVN: Hearing the Bani of the Lord's Name, all my affairs were brought to perfection and embellished.
Hearing the world of Lord's Name all my affairs got adjusted and embellished, O Lord.
J7WP: With each and every hair, with each and every hair, as Gurmukh, I meditate on the Lord.
With every hair, every hair of mine I meditate on the Lord, through the Guru.
FBEV: I meditate on the Lord's Name, and become pure; He has no form or shape.
I have become pure by remembering the Name of the Lord, who has no form and outline.
B33T: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, is permeating my heart deep within, and all of my desire and hunger has disappeared.
Lord's Name is contained in my heart, and my desire and hunger have all disappeared.
LZZ6: My mind and body are totally adorned with peace and tranquility; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord has been revealed to me.
By Guru's instruction the Lord is revealed to me, and my mind and body are all adorned with peace.
6YRL: The Lord Himself has shown His kind mercy to Nanak; He has made me the slave of the slaves of His slaves. ||3||
The Lord Himself has shown mercy to Nanak and He has make me the slave of the slaves of His slaves.
2GN5: Those who forget the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, are foolish, unfortunate, self-willed manmukhs.
Self-willed, foolish and unfortunate are they who have forgotten the name of the Lord Master.
M8NL: Within, they are engrossed in emotional attachment; each and every moment, Maya clings to them.
Their heart is engrossed in worldly love, and every moment, mammon remains attached to them.
9A80: The filth of Maya clings to them, and they become unfortunate fools - they do not love the Lord's Name.
The filth of worldly-valuables clings to them who love not Lord's Name, they become unfortunate fools.
9Z8H: The egotistical and proud perform all sorts of rituals, but they shy away from the Lord's Name.
The men of ego perform many rituals, but they hesitate to remember Lord God's Name.
23RQ: The path of Death is very arduous and painful; it is stained with the darkness of emotional attachment.
Extremely arduous and painful is the Death's path, stained with the darkness of worldly love.
HK3A: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and finds the gate of salvation. ||4||
Nanak, if through the Guru, the mortal meditates on the Name, then, he finds the gate of salvation.
RC8U: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and the Lord Guru, are known by the Gurmukh.
The Lord's Master's Name and great Pervading God are known, through the Guru.
DFBY: One moment, this mind is in the heavens, and the next, it is in the nether regions; the Guru brings the wandering mind back to one-pointedness.
In a moment this mind is in heaven, and in a moment in nether region. The Guru brings back the wandering mind into one home (on one point).
05X5: When the mind returns to one-pointedness, one totally understands the value of salvation, and enjoys the subtle essence of the Lord's Name.
When the mind returns to the one home, the man wholly realises the worth of salvation and enjoys the relish of Lord God's Name.
6R3S: The Lord's Name preserves the honor of His servant, as He preserved and emancipated Prahlaad.
Lord's Name preserves the honour of His servant, as He emancipated and saved Prahlad.
NLDH: So repeat continually the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; chanting His Glorious Virtues, His limit cannot be found.
Continually repeat you the lofty Lord's Name, by narrating whose praises his limit cannot be found.
FWHY: Nanak is drenched in happiness, hearing the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Name of the Lord. ||5||
Hearing Lord's Name, Nanak is drenched in happiness and has merged in the Lord's Name.
TQZT: Those beings, whose minds are filled with the Lord's Name, forsake all anxiety.
They within whose mind Lord's Name abides, forsake all the anxieties.
NU16: They obtain all wealth, and all Dharmic faith, and the fruits of their minds' desires.
They obtain all the wealth and all piety and obtain the fruit which their mind desires.
R257: They obtain the fruits of their hearts' desires, meditating on the Lord's Name, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
Meditating on Lord's Name and singing the praise of Lord's Name man gathers his heat-desired boon.
NC2H: Evil-mindedness and duality depart, and their understanding is enlightened. They attach their minds to the Name of the Lord.
His evil inclination and mal-intellect depart, he obtains right understanding and attaches his mind to the Lord's Name.

03B8: Their lives and bodies become totally blessed and fruitful; the Lord's Name illumines them.
Profitable becomes the life and the whole body, in which the Lord's Name is illumined.
6NDH: O Nanak, by continually vibrating upon the Lord, day and night, the Gurmukhs abide in the home of the inner self. ||6||
Nanak, by ever remembering God, day and night, the pious person abides in his own home.
RQUA: Those who place their faith in the Lord's Name, do not attach their consciousness to another.
They who have faith in the Lord's Name, attach not their mind to another.
HME9: Even if the entire earth were to be transformed into gold, and given to them, without the Naam, they love nothing else.
Even if the whole earth be transformed into gold and be delivered to them, without the Name they love nothing else.
7DSR: The Lord's Name is pleasing to their minds, and they obtain supreme peace; when they depart in the end, it shall go with them as their support.
The Lord's Name is pleasing to their mind and through it they attain supreme bliss and when departing in the end, it goes with them as their succourer.
MBLU: I have gathered the capital, the wealth of the Lord's Name; it does not sink, and does not depart.
I have amassed the capital of the Lord's Name's wealth. It neither sinks nor parts company.
EECU: The Lord's Name is the only true support in this age; the Messenger of Death does not draw near it.
The Lord's Name in this age is the only support. Death's courier draws not near it.
A9F0: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs recognize the Lord; in His Mercy, He unites them with Himself. ||7||
Nanak, through the Guru, the Lord is recognised, and He mercifully unites man with Himself.
K2XK: True, True is the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the Gurmukh knows the Lord.
True, true is the Lord Master Name. it is realised, through the Guru.
F92B: The Lord's servant is the one who commits himself to the Guru's service, and dedicates his mind and body as an offering to Him.
Lord's slave is he, who embraces Guru's service, dedicates his heart and body and makes an offering of them to him.
FARM: He dedicates his mind and body to Him, placing great faith in Him; the Guru lovingly unites His servant with Himself.
The servant, who tenders his mind and body entertains immense faith, him the Guru unites in his love.
CJF2: The Master of the meek, the Giver of souls, is obtained through the Perfect Guru.
The Master of the meek and the Donor of the beings is obtained through the Perfect Guru.
RQHX: The Guru's Sikh, and the Sikh's Guru, are one and the same; both spread the Guru's Teachings.
Guru's Sikh and Sikh's Guru, are one and the same and both propagate Guru's mission.
3431: The Mantra of the Lord's Name is enshrined within the heart, O Nanak, and we merge with the Lord so easily. ||8||2||9||
The spell of the Lord's Name, the Guru enshrines in the Sikh's mind, O Nanak and he easily meets the Lord.
V3RY: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace. He is obtained.
58P0: Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Second House:
G54L: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.
Lord's God the Creator is the Destroyer of distress and His Name is the Purifier of sinners.
VHNH: One who lovingly serves the Lord, obtains the supreme status. Service to the Lord, Har, Har, is more exalted than anything.
He, who loves God's service, obtains the supreme rank. The Lord Master's service is superior to every other dead.
HKC5: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the most exalted occupation; chanting the Name of the Lord, one becomes immortal.
From every point of view the meditation of God's Name is an excellent avocation and by this meditation, man becomes eternal.
7QED: The pains of both birth and death are eradicated, and one comes to sleep in peaceful ease.
He effaces the pain of both birth and death and naturally sleeps in peace.
KBFX: O Lord, O Lord and Master, shower Your Mercy upon me; within my mind, I chant the Name of the Lord.
O Lord God, the Master, show mercy to me. Within my mind I ponder on You, O Lord God.
6RVA: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||
Lord God, the Creator is the Destroyer of distress and this Name is the Purifier of the sinners.
K24Q: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru.
Sublime is the wealth of God's Name in the Dark age. Meditate you on God in the True Guru's way.
6B95: As Gurmukh, read of the Lord; as Gurmukh, hear of the Lord. Chanting and listening to the Lord's Name, pain departs.
Through the Guru, read you of God and through the Guru, hear you of God. By remembering and hearing the Name of God, pain departs.
BSBW: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, pains are removed. Through the Name of the Lord, supreme peace is obtained.
Contemplating on Lord God's Name, agony is removed. Through the Name of God supreme bliss is attained.
PNU5: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru illumines the heart; this Light dispels the darkness of spiritual ignorance.
The Sat-Guru-given-gnosis is lit up in the heart, with whose light is dispelled the darkness of spiritual ignorance.
ZRSP: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, Har, Har, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written.
They alone meditate on Lord God's Name on whose forehead it is so written by the Primal Lord.
P4PF: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru. ||2||
In the Dark age sublime is the wealth of God's Name. Meditate you on God in the way of the True Guru.
0DFV: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profit of the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa.
He, whose mind loves the Lord God, attains supreme peace and reaps the profit of God of the state of salvation.
MXSA: He embraces love for the Lord, and the Lord's Name becomes his companion. His doubts, and his comings and goings are ended.
He embraces love for God and God's Name becomes his helper and his wanderings, comings and going come to an end.

XNBF: His comings and goings, doubts and fears come to an end, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
Flee his coming, goings, doubts and dreads and he sings Lord God Master's praise.
STK4: The sins and pains of countless incarnations are washed away, and he merges into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
His sins and ills of many births are washed off and merges he into the Lord Master's Name.
U57B: Those who are blessed by such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Lord, and their lives become fruitful and approved.
Who have such a pre-ordained destiny, meditate they on God and fruitful and approved becomes their advent.
8CG3: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profit of the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa. ||3||
He, whose soul loves the Lord Master, obtains the supreme bliss and reaps the profit of God in the form of the state of salvation.
0V65: Celebrated are those people, to whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har.
Foremost (Eminent) are the persons to whom God seems sweet, Sublime are these men of Lord God.
Y5LN: The Lord's Name is their glorious greatness; the Lord's Name is their companion and helper. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord.
God's Name is their honour, and God's name is their succourer and under the Guru's instruction they enjoy God's Nectar.
0YUP: They enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, and remain totally detached. By great good fortune, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord.
God's elixir enjoy and remain thoroughly detached. Though the greatest good luck they obtain the Lord's ambrosia.
F13X: So very blessed and truly perfect are those, who through Guru's Instruction meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Greatly blessed and truly perfect persons are they, who through Guru's instruction meditate on the Name.
JUA2: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy; his mind is rid of sorrow and separation.
Servant Nanak, prays for the dust of saints feet, Wherewith his soul is rid of sorrow and separation.
59WT: Celebrated are those people, to whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||10||
Foremost are the persons to whom God seems sweet. Sublime are these men of Lord God.
S86S: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet.
In the Gold-age all men, were contented and meditative and the religion had four feet,
GX3B: With mind and body, they sang of the Lord, and attained supreme peace. In their hearts was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues.
With their mind and body they sang of God and acquired the greatest peace. In every heart was the knowledge of God's excellences.
XH13: Their wealth was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues; the Lord was their success, and to live as Gurmukh was their glory.
The knowledge of Lord's merits was their wealth, God's Name their success and to be virtuous their glory.
CND3: Inwardly and outwardly, they saw only the One Lord God; for them there was no other second.
Within and without they saw the one Lord God. For them there was no other second.
64MC: They centered their consciousness lovingly on the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name was their companion, and in the Court of the Lord, they obtained honor.
With God's Name they fixed their attention, God's Name was their helper and in God's court they acquired honour.
JB2P: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet. ||1||
In the Satiyug (Truth age), every one was contented and meditate and religion had four feet.
DU97: Then came the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga; men's minds were ruled by power, and they practiced celibacy and self-discipline.

The Doaparyuga (Brass age) came and people began to wander in doubt. The Lord created the milk-maids and Krishan.

God made the Kalyuga (the iron age) in which the religion lost three legs and the fourth leg remained intact.

Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru, who has shown him the Name in his heart and soul.
PFB7: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact. ||4||4||11||
God created the dark-age the religion lost three legs and the fourth leg remained intact.
R7AG: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems so sweet to her mind and body.
She to whose mind, is pleasing the Lord's praise, and to whose soul and body God seems sweet, attains the highest status.
2TPX: She obtains the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, she meditates on the Lord, and the destiny written on her forehead is fulfilled.
She obtains Lord's God's elixir. Through Guru instruction meditates she on God and the eternal writ of destiny in her brow is fulfilled.
PBFQ: By that high destiny written on her forehead, she chants the Name of the Lord, her Husband, and through the Name of the Lord, she sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.
By virtue of the primal writ of good luck on her forehead, she repeats the Name of God, her spouse and through God's Name, she sings her Lord's praise.
KNN4: The jewel of immense love sparkles on her forehead, and she is adorned with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
On her forehead sparkles the gem of great love and she is bedecked with the Name of the Lord Master.
32HH: Her light blends with the Supreme Light, and she obtains God; meeting the True Guru, her mind is satisfied.
Her light blends with the Supreme light and she obtain her Lord. By meeting the true Guru, her soul is satiated.
VMJM: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems sweet to her mind and body. ||1||
She, to whose mind is pleasing the Lord's praise and to whose soul and body God seems sweet. attain the supreme rank.
A7GM: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people.
They, who sing Lord Master's praise, gain the supreme rank. They are the sublime and foremost among men.
JA3L: I bow at their feet; each and every moment, I wash the feet of those, to whom the Lord seems sweet.
Their feet, I worship and their feet I wash, every moment to whom God seems sweet.
TT7J: The Lord seems sweet to them, and they obtain the supreme status; their faces are radiant and beautiful with good fortune.
She, to whom God seems sweet, gathers supreme solace, and beautiful is her fortunate face.
Q1LR: Under Guru's Instruction, they sing the Lord's Name, and wear the garland of the Lord's Name around their necks; they keep the Lord's Name in their throats.
By Guru's instruction she sings God's praise, wears God as garland around her neck and keeps God's Name on her tongue or in the throat.
2PS8: They look upon all with equality, and recognize the Supreme Soul, the Lord, pervading among all.
Sees she every one with the eye, i.e. alike, and recognises she the pervading soul among all.
8UPA: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people. ||2||
They who sing Lord God's praise, obtain the supreme status and they are the exquisite and the most eminent persons.
FYEJ: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord.
He, to whose mind the society of saints is pleasing, relishes God's elixir. In the society of saints abides the Lord. essence.
T2K9: He meditates in adoration upon the Lord, Har, Har, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he blossoms forth. He plants no other seed.
He meditates on Lord God and through Guru's word remains in bloom. Sans God he knows not another Second.
HAMW: There is no Nectar, other than the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. One who drinks it in, knows the way.
Save the Lord elixir, there is no other elixir. He alone knows its way, who quaffs it.
N6VE: Hail, hail to the Perfect Guru; through Him, God is found. Joining the Sangat, the Naam is understood.
Hail, hail to the prefect Guru, through whom the Lord is procured joining type society of saints Lord's Name is recognised.
GF2D: I serve the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. Without the Naam, there is no other at all.
The Name I serve, the name I meditate upon and without the Name there is not another.
44CJ: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord. ||3||
He, to whose mind the society of saints is dear, relishes the God's elixir. In the saints guild abides the Lord's Nectar.
VGRZ: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across, and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad.
My Lord God shower Yours benediction on me, the stone; ferry me You across, and peacefully pull me out of the ocean.
80VL: I am stuck in the swamp of emotional attachment, and I am sinking. O Lord God, please, take me by the arm.
I am struck in the mire of worldly love and am sinking. O Lord God, let me take hold of Your Arm.
4R1A: God took me by the arm, and I obtained the highest understanding; as His slave, I grasped the Guru's feet.
The Lord held me by the arm, I gained sublime understanding and I his slave, clung to Guru's feet.

HB2Y: I chant and meditate in adoration upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, according to the good destiny written upon my forehead.
He, who has good destiny written on his face and forehead ponders and reflects on the Lord master.
B3MR: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, seems so sweet to his mind.
God has shown mercy to slave Nanak, and God's Name seems sweet to his mind.
MUY5: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across, and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||12||
My Lord God, shower Your benediction on me, the stone ferry me You across and peacefully pull me out of the world ocean.
L5R0: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har in his mind - the Lord is pleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is a great yearning for the Lord.
He, who from heart repeats the Name, to his mind God's Name is pleasing in the mind of the pious persons is great yearning for God.
SA6Z: Those humble beings who remain dead while yet alive, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; through the Guru's Teachings, their minds embrace love for the Lord.
The persons, who remain dead in life, they drink Nectar, and their mind, under Guru's instruction imbibes love for the Lord.
ZVCS: Their minds love the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru is Merciful to them. They are Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive, and they are at peace.
In their mind is the Lord God's love and to them, Guru is merciful They are emancipate while alive and to them, Guru is merciful. They are emancipate while alive and so are in peace.
0H7S: Their birth and death, through the Name of the Lord, are illustrious, and in their hearts and minds, the Lord, Har, Har, abides.
Through God's Name, their birth and dead become illustrious, and in their mind and heart is He, the Lord Master.
2D6C: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, abides in their minds, and through the Guru's Teachings, they savor the Lord, Har, Har; they drink in the sublime essence of the Lord with abandon.
In their mind abides God's Name, by Guru's instruction they relish God and the Lord God's Nectar they drink in big draughts.
BQZ8: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his mind - the Lord is pleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is such a great yearning for the Lord. ||1||
He, who heartily repeats the Name, to his mind, God's Name is pleasing. In the mind of the pious persons is great yearning for God.
0YBT: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away.
The man in the world likes not death and ever conceals himself from it, lest the Death's courier should catch and take him away.
XEBQ: Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is the One and Only; this soul cannot be concealed from Him.
Within and without the Unique Lord God, the Master, is present, and this soul cannot be kept concealed from Him.
1JCV: How can one keep one's soul, when the Lord wishes to have it? All things belong to Him, and He shall take them away.
How can one hold one's soul, when God wishes to have it? He to whom the thing belongs shall take is away.
60T2: The self-willed manmukhs wander around in pathetic lamentation, trying all medicines and remedies.
The Self-willed wander about in pathetic lamentation and try all meditation and cures.
TMJ1: God, the Master, to whom all things belong, shall take them away; the Lord's servant is redeemed by living the Word of the Shabad.
The Lord Master, to whom the thing belongs, shall take it away. The Lord's slave is redeemed by practising the World.
Q8QN: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away. ||2||
The Man in the world likes not death and ever conceals himself from it, lest the Death's courier should seize and take him away.
D7W8: Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.
Death's time is pre-writ the Guru-wards look beauteous through Lord God's meditation and His slaves are saved.
D897: Through the Lord they obtain honor, and through the Lord's Name, glorious greatness. In the Court of the Lord, they are robed in honor.
By God's Name they attain honour and Divine glory, and go the God's court clothed in rove of honour.
Y6JG: Robed in honor in the Court of the Lord, in the perfection of the Lord's Name, they obtain peace through the Lord's Name.
Roved at God's court and perfected, with the Name, they obtain peace through God's Name.
2U2Q: The pains of both birth and death are eliminated, and they merge into the Name of the Lord.
Their pain of both birth and death is annulled and they merge into the Lord God's Name.
60K7: The Lord's servants meet with God and merge into Oneness. The Lord's servant and God are one and the same.
Meeting together God's slave and God becomes one. The Lord and Lord's slaves are one and the Same.
3E5K: Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
Death's time is preordained. The pious persons look beauteous. Through the meditation of Lord God, his slaves are saved.

The mortal (world) is born to die and is ever destroyed but by attaching to the Supreme Guru, man becomes immortal.
KGLG: The Guru implants His Mantra within the heart, and one savors the sublime essence of the Lord; the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord trickles into his mouth.
The Guru implants the Name spell in man's mind and in his mouth trickles the Lord Master elixir Thus enjoys God's Nectar.
CWY1: Obtaining the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord, the dead are restored to life, and do not die again.
Receiving the God's immortalising nectar the dead one is restored to life and then dies not again.
BXRK: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, one obtains the immortal status, and merges into the Lord's Name.
By Lord master's name man obtains the immortal status and into God's name merges he.
H5VT: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only Support and Anchor of servant Nanak; without the Naam, there is nothing else at all.
The name alone is the prop and support of servant Nanak. Without the Name he has no other resting place.
502G: The people of the world are born, only to perish, and perish, and perish again. Only by attaching oneself to the Lord as Gurmukh, does one become permanent. ||4||6||13||
The world is born to die and is ever destroyed but attaching to the supreme Guru it becomes ever-stable (immortal)

RWU7: Akal Purakh is One, and He is met through the grace of the Satguru.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By true Guru is grace. He is obtained.

Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, Fourth House:

The Lord applied His touch-stone to my mind, and found it one hundred per cent gold.
My master applied his touch-stone to my soul and found it hundred percent gold.

O Ram! The mind set upon the touchstone which is Your Nam becomes (sovinna) of excellent colour, or gold purified by a hundred firings. Gold of twelve firings is called pure; this is gold assayed and purified by a hundred firings — the sense being, it has become possessed of the highest bliss.
Z0WT: Gurmukhi = by taking the Guru's shelter. Chalulia = has been dyed with deep crimson. Tano = tanu, body, heart.

As Gurmukh, I am dyed in the deep red of the poppy, and my mind and body are drenched with His Love.

By way of the Gurus my mind and body are soaked in the deep dye — the sense being, in the bliss of the atma.

My great Lord is unapproachable incomprehensible primal immaculate and formless.

His condition cannot be described immeasurable is his glory My world - Lord is invisible and infinite.

2RTN: What should these poor creatures say? How can they speak of and describe You?

KJYK: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless. ||1||
My great Lord is unreachable unapprehensible eternal pure and formless
NQZ5: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found.
O primal Lord you are the remotest of the remote creator. Your limit cannot be ascertained.
YV9W: You are pervading and permeating each and every heart, everywhere, You are contained in all.
You are uninterruptedly present in all the hearts and in everything you are contained among all.
C6XR: Within the heart is the Transcendent, Supreme Lord God, whose limits cannot be found.
Within the mind is the transcendent Lord the Supreme master whose end cannot be found.
V42N: He has no form or shape; He is unseen and unknown. The Gurmukh sees the unseen Lord.
He has no form or outline He is unseeable and unknowable The invisible Lord is beheld by Guru's instruction
K0HK: He remains in continual ecstasy, day and night, and is spontaneously absorbed into the Naam.
He who perceives the Lord ever remains happy day and night and is easily absorbed in his Name.
WMJG: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found. ||2||
O primal Lord you are the illimitable creator your limit cannot be found.

You are the true supreme master ever imperishable the Lord God is the treasure of excellences (virtues)
9W8S: The Lord God, Har, Har, is the One and only; there is no other at all. You Yourself are the all-knowing Lord.
Lord God the master is but one there is not any other you yourself are the omniscient Lord
Q8HJ: You are the all-knowing Lord, the most exalted and auspicious; there is no other as great as You.
You are the all knowing and the most exalted Lord None is so great as you.
T3ST: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading in all; whatever You do, comes to pass.
Yours is the command you pervadest all the thing. What yourself does that comes to pass.
5GZG: The One Lord God is permeating all; the Gurmukh comes to understand the Lord's Name.
He the one Lord is contained among all and through the Guru God is Name is comprehended
07PR: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue. ||3||
You are the true supreme master and are ever imperishable. The Lord God is the treasure of excellences
DQA3: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act.
You are the Creator off all greatness is thin and as it pleseth You so drivest you the mortal.
JUQY: As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. All are merged into Your Shabad.
As you Yourself likest, so drivest you the mortals.
H702: When it pleases Your Will, we obtain greatness through Your Shabad.
All are merged in (subject to) your command subject to your order are all and when you so willest man gets greatness through the Name.
G6B3: The Gurmukh obtains wisdom, and eliminates his self-conceit, and remains absorbed in the Shabad.
Through the Guru one obtains wisdom effaces his self conceit and remains absorbed in the Lord.
7U9Z: The Gurmukh obtains Your incomprehensible Shabad; O Nanak, he remains merged in the Naam.
Nanak through the Guru your incomprehensible Name is obtained and the man remains absorbed in O Lord.
PE23: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. ||4||7||14||
You are the Creator of all. All greatness is yours. As it pleasth you so drivest you the mortals.

Z41R: Muski = with musk. Jhakolia = has become thoroughly perfumed. Dhanu dhanna = fortunate, fruitful ||1||
(By the Guru's grace) servant Nanak has become thoroughly perfumed with the musk (of Prabhu's Nam); (servant Nanak's) whole life has become fortunate. ||1||
Servant Nanak is drenched with His Fragrance; blessed, blessed is his entire life. ||1||
Slave Nanak is soaked in Lord's perfume and blessed is his entire life.
Sri Guru Ji says: my mind has (jhakolia) mingled in the (muski) fragrance which is Your praise; by that, this whole human birth has become fit for the greatest blessedness. ||1||
5N5B: Aniale = having a point, (arrows) with sharp points.
The Gurbani that produces love for Prabhu's feet has pierced my mind, as arrows with sharp points pierce (a thing).
The Bani of the Lord's Love is the pointed arrow, which has pierced my mind, O Lord King.
The hymn of God's love is the pointed arrow which has smitten my heart O Lord.
O Hari Ram Raje! Your bani full of love, which is (aniale) arrows with barbed points — by those the mind has been slain.
AAX6: Pir = pain, ache. Piramm = love. Jaria = it is borne.

He alone who feels the pain of love know how to endure it.
He to whom the pain of love has come — he alone who bears it knows.

He how effaces his ownself and is dead in life is said to have been emancipated while alive.
(Mari jivai) He who has died to the sense of being a separate self through the updesh of those who are gurmukhs, he alone is called jivan mukat.
L3ET: Dutaru = that which is hard to cross ||2||
O servant Nanak! (Say —) O Hari! Unite me with the Guru, so that I may cross this world (-ocean), which is hard to cross. ||2||
O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the True Guru, that he may cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
O God unit servant Nanak with the true Guru that be may cross the arduous world-ocean.
Sri Guru Ji says: O Hari! Unite me with such a Satiguru as by whom the hard-to-cross world may be crossed. ||2||
FSJ9: Mugadh = foolish, senseless. Govind = O Govind! Ranga = one who performs many plays and shows.
O Govind, master of countless wondrous plays! Meet (us); we, foolish and senseless, have come to Your shelter.
I am foolish and ignorant, but I have taken to His Sanctuary; may I merge in the Love of the Lord of the Universe, O Lord King.
I ignorant and stupid have entered Guru is asylum may I be blessed with Lord's love
O Ram Raje Govind! We, foolish, (mugadh) children, or more foolish than fools, have come into Your shelter. (Ranga) O You whose form is bliss! Unite us with Yourself.

Through the Perfect Guru, I have obtained the Lord, and I beg for the one blessing of devotion to the Lord.

O Hari! From the perfect Gurus, having begged the one bhagti of Yours, I have obtained You, Hari.

My mind and body blossom forth through the Word of the Shabad; I meditate on the Lord of infinite waves.
By Guru's hymns my soul and body have bloomed and I meditate on the Lord of endless (infinite) waves.
O (anat taranga) assumer of countless forms! By repeating You through the Guru's shabad, my (tanu) subtle mind and my body have (vigasia) blossomed.
QZ8P: Mili = having met {the difference between the words 'milu' and 'mili' is worth remembering} ||3||

Meeting with the humble Saints, Nanak finds the Lord, in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||
On meeting the holy men Nanak obtained God in the society of saints.
Sri Guru Ji says: O Hari! Having joined the satsang of the sant jan, I have obtained You. ||3||
S2LT: Daial = O house of mercy! Prabh = O Prabhu! Hari raia = O Prabhu the Emperor!

O Merciful to the meek, hear my prayer, O Lord God; You are my Master, O Lord King.
O God compassionate to the poor heart my supplication O God, you are my Lord and my King.
O Ram Raje, Hari Rai, Hari Prabh, merciful to the humble! Hear one supplication of mine.
EKJP: Hau = I. Magau = magaun, I beg. Sarani = support, shelter. Mukhi = in the mouth.

I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name, Har, Har; please, place it in my mouth.
I pray for the refuge of God s Name O my Lord God! put it into my mouth.
O Hari! I beg the shelter of Your Nam, by which the jap of Hari Hari may be put into my mouth; may I keep putting the amrit of the Hari Hari Nam into my mouth.
9FY8: Bhagati vachhalu = one who loves bhagti. Biradu = disposition from the very beginning. Laj = honour.
It is Parmatma's disposition from the very beginning that He loves bhagti; (whoever comes to His shelter) He keeps that one's honour.
It is the Lord's natural way to love His devotees; O Lord, please preserve my honor!
To love His devotees is the inherent disposition of God save my honour O Lord.
O Hari, lover of bhagats! This is Your (birad) vow; (Hari) whoever comes to Your shelter, You have gone on keeping that one's honour.
9607: Nami = by way of the Nam ||4||8||15||

Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, and has been saved by the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||15||
Servant Nanak has entered yours sanctuary O God and your Name has saved him.
Sri Guru Ji says: O Hari, possessor of the Nam! By the Nam You have ferried the bhagats across; therefore I am in Your shelter — ferry me across as well. ||4||8||15||
JSQU: Gurmukhi = taking the Guru's shelter. Ladha = has been found.
Taking the Guru's shelter, searching and searching, I have found the friend-Prabhu (within my own self).
As Gurmukh, I searched and searched, and found the Lord, my Friend, my Sovereign Lord King.

Within the walled castle of my golden body the Lord God is revealed.

That (kaia) fort which is the body, worth a crore of gold — that is to say, priceless — within that, by all the proofs, (hari) Hari has been established. As in: ☬ 'Bahar dhudhan te chhut pare gur ghar hi mahi dikhaia tha.'
E839: Vidha = has been pierced. Dhuri = from the very court.
(Within my own self) Parmatma's Nam-jewel, Parmatma's Nam-diamond (has been found), by which my (hard) mind, my (hard) heart has been pierced (has become soft).
The Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel, a diamond; my mind and body are pierced through.
The Lord master is a jewel and ruby wherewith my soul and body are pierced.
The Hari Hari Nam is itself this diamond and jewel, which has pierced my mind and body; or, in it my mind and body have been merged.
KVVG: Rasi = in the relish, in the bliss. Gudha = I have been steeped ||1||
O Nanak! (Say — O brother!) From the very presence of Prabhu, by great good fortune, Parmatma has been met by me; my own self has been steeped in the relish of His love. ||1||

Predestined as very fortunate I have obtained God. Nanak is kneaded with His Nectar.

I, a girl like youthful bride of my Lord the king stand ever and inquire the road to him.
I, the (mundh) woman possessed of youth and of the highest love, stand daily and attentively asking the (panthu) road of Hari, Ram Raje.
HNKC: Gur = O Guru! Chetai = cause to remember. Margi = upon the road. Chali = may I walk.

The Guru has caused me to remember the Name of Lord God and I now tread the way to God.
O Guru! Cause me to make the simran of the Hari Hari Nam, by which I may become one able to walk upon Hari's road.
94AE: Mani = in the mind. Tani = in the heart. Adharu = support. Bikhu = poison. Jali = jalin, may I burn, may I burn away.
In my mind, in my heart, Prabhu's Nam alone is the support (if Your mercy be, then by the grace of this Nam) may I burn away the poison of haumai from within me.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body; I have burnt away the poison of ego.
Within my mind and body is the support of the Name and I have burnt down the poison of pride
In my mind and in my body the Nam alone is the support; the poison of I-ness and mine-ness I have burnt away.
U0TA: Meli = may I meet. Banvali = Parmatma ||2||
O servant Nanak! (Say — O Prabhu! Unite me with) the Guru! Whoever has met Parmatma has met Him only by way of the Guru. ||2||
O True Guru, unite me with the Lord, unite me with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||2||
O my God unite servant Nanak with true Guru who himself is united with the flower-bedecked Lord.
Sri Guru Ji says: unite me with that Satigur, O Hari Banvali! whom You have met.
2KEE: Gurmukhi = by way of the Guru. Piare = O beloved Hari! Mai = to me.
O beloved Hari! Come and meet me, long separated, by way of the Guru.
O my Love, come and meet me as Gurmukh; I have been separated from You for so long, Lord King.
Through the Guru come and meet me O my beloved since long I have been separated from you.
O Ram Raje, Beloved! Come and meet me, separated for a long age, by way of the Gurus.
AZMN: Bairagia = has become desolate. Rasi = with the (love) water. Bhinne = soaked.
O Hari! My mind, my heart is greatly desolate; my eyes are soaked with (Your) love-water (because of the separation).
My mind and body are sad; my eyes are wet with the Lord's sublime essence.
My mind and body are gone very sad My eyes are moist with God's ambrosia.
Without meeting, my mind and body have become greatly (bairagia) desolate. O Hari! My eyes stay soaked in Your relish — that is to say, they stay wet.
JNUZ: Mili = having met. Manne = may it be satisfied, may it take assurance.
O Hari! Give me word of the beloved Guru; having met the Guru, may my mind grow accustomed to Your remembrance.
Show me my Lord God, my Love, O Guru; meeting the Lord, my mind is pleased.
My Guru show me the Lord God my love meeting Him my mind is pleased.
O Guru! Tell me of the beloved Hari Prabh, that, O Hari! having met with You my mind may (manne) be satisfied.
6PBQ: O Nanak! (Say —) O Hari! I am a fool; join me to Your own work (of the simran of the Nam). ||3||
I am just a fool, O Nanak, but the Lord has appointed me to perform His service. ||3||
Me a fool Guru Nanak has appointed to perform the service, the service of God.
Sri Guru Ji says: set me, a fool, to the work which is the bhagti of Hari; then we shall be of some use.(1) ||3||
1MJB: Gur dehuri = the Guru's fair body. Amrit = the Nam-water that gives spiritual life. Burke = he sprinkles (into the hearts and bodies of others).
The Guru's fair heart stays always soaked with the Nam-water that gives spiritual life; that (Guru goes on sprinkling this) Nam-water that gives spiritual life (into the hearts of others as well).
The Guru's body is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar; He sprinkles it upon me, O Lord King.
The Guru's body is drenched with the nectar of God the King and he has sprinkled the Lord's nectar on me.
The body of the Gurus is soaked with the Nam of Ram Raje, and the Guru gives (burke) sprinklings of the amrit of Hari's Nam — that is to say, he gives the updesh.
7KBS: Mani = in the mind. Bhaia = bhai, became dear. Amriti = with the amrit, with the water that gives spiritual life. Chhaki chhake = chhaki chhaki, enjoying and enjoying.

Those whose minds are pleased with the Word of the Guru's Bani, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar again and again.

Those to whom the Guru's bani seems good within their own mind, their minds become of one substance with the Nam-amrit.
3B62: Tuthai = by becoming merciful. Chuke = have come to an end. Dhak dhake = the daily shoves, the daily stumbles.

As the Guru is pleased, the Lord is obtained, and you shall not be pushed around any more.

Those who have obtained Hari by the pleasedness of the Gurus, their (dhak dhake) doubts have been released.
ZWJD: O Nanak! Parmatma and Parmatma's servant become of one form; the servant is absorbed into Parmatma. ||4||9||16||

With the great True Guru is the treasure of God's ambrosial devotional service.
(Gur) With those great ones who are the Satigur is the treasury of the amrit which is the bhagti of Hari Ram Raje.
EDD3: Sacha sahu = the banker of the ever-abiding Nam-treasury. Sikh = to the Sikhs. Dei = he gives. Rase = rasi, capital, stock.

The great True Guru is the True banker who gives his disciple the Lord s capital.
The worshipful Satiguru is the true banker; he gives to the Sikh the (rase) capital which is the Hari Nam.
SDLT: (The trade of Prabhu-bhagti) is the highest trade; fortunate is that man who carries on this trade; the Guru, the banker of the Nam-wealth, gives that man his applause.

Blessed, blessed is the trader and the trade, and all honour is into Guru, the merchant.
Blessed is the (vanaju) commerce of the Hari Nam, and to the (guru) banker also is (sabase) thanksgiving, who has such trade carried on.
UMK0: Jin lilati = upon whose forehead. Dhuri = from the very court. Likhase = has been written ||1||

O slave Nanak, they alone obtained Guru who have such a pre-ordained writ on there forehead.

Q6G8: Sachu = ever-abiding. Dhani = master. Sabhu = whole.

You are my True Banker, O Lord; the whole world is Your trader, O Lord King.
You, O my Master, are the True Banker, and the whole world is a dealer of Yours.
O Ram Raje, true banker! You are our (dhani) Master, and the whole world is Your trader.

All the vessels You have fashioned and the thing within, is also Yours, O God.
All the (bhande) bodies You have made; O Hari! Within them the thing is (thara) Your own form.

The thing which You puts into the vessel, that alone comes out. What can any.

Whatever thing is put into a vessel, that alone comes out; in this what reflection will anyone else make? The sense being this, that apart from Brahm there is nothing else at all; 'sabh gobind hai sabh gobind hai' — this will be established.

C7KD: O Hari! To Your servant Nanak too it is You alone who (showing mercy) have granted the treasury of Your own bhagti. ||2||

To servant Nanak, God has donated the treasure of His love-adoration.

O Master, Ram Raje! Which of Your virtues shall we set out in detail? You indeed are apar and apar.
0PZ5: O Master! We perform the praise of Your Nam alone night and day; this alone is the support of our life, this alone the prop.

God's Name, I praise day and night, and this alone is my hope and support.
O Hari! We perform the glory of Your Nam alone night and day, and of the Nam alone we keep the support with body and mind.
4Q7S: Kichhua = anything at all. Na janha = we do not know. Kiv = how? Pavah = may we find. Paro = the far shore, the limit.

I am a fool, and I know nothing. How can I find Your limits?
I am a fool and know nothing. How can I find Your limit?
O Master! We fools know no sadhan at all; how shall we find the far shore of the world-ocean?
S6V8: Servant Nanak is the servant of Parmatma, the servant of Parmatma's servants. ||3||
Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord, the water-carrier of the slaves of the Lord. ||3||
Attendant Nanak is God's servant, nay, the water-carrier of God's slaves.

RR5B: Bhavai = may seem good (to You). Prabh = O Prabhu!

As it pleases You, so do You save me and I have sought Yours refuge, O Lord Master, the king.
O (Ram Raje) Prabhu! We have come into Your shelter; in whatever way it seems good to You, take us into Your shelter.
As it pleases You God, keep me. I have come to Your sanctuary, beloved God.

I am wandering around, ruining myself day and night; O Lord, please save my honor!
I am straying and spoiling myself day and night. O God, save You my honour.
We, going astray from Your hukam, spoil night and day — that is to say, we commit sins; do You keep my honour.
I stray from the path and ruin my life day and night, God, please protect my dignity (or honour).
B000: De = having given. Samjhae = samjhai, grant understanding.

I am child and You, O Guru, are my father. Do You instruct me and put me on the right track.
We are children and You are Guru and father. As one may be made to understand, so give us good sense and make us understand.
I am Your child, You are my Guru and Father, please give me Your wisdom and help me understand (how to live).
02AY: Kandhia = is said to be, is called. Paij = honour. Rakhae = rakhai, keep ||4||10||17||

Servant Nanak is known publicly as Your slave. God, please uphold my honour (reputation).

Those who have the blessed pre-ordained destiny of the Lord written on their foreheads, meet the True Guru, the Lord King.
They alone. who have such a writ of God on their forehead, since the very beginning, them the True Guru meets.
O Hari Ram Raje! Those upon whose forehead You have inscribed a good writ from the very beginning, they have met the Satiguru.
ZWLK: Agianu = unawareness of spiritual life. Andhera = darkness. Ghati = in the heart. Balia = shone out.

They find the wealth of the jewel of God's Name and then wander not, again.

Servant Nanak has meditated on the Name and through meditation he has met the Lord.

Those who have not kept the Lord's Name in their consciousness - why did they bother to come into the world, O Lord King?
They, who did not contemplate on such a Name of God, why did they come in this world?
O Ram Raje! Those who have not contemplated such a Hari-Nam, why have they come into the world — that is to say, they were born in vain.

Very difficult to obtain is this human birth and without the Name, it all goes in vain.
This human birth is durlabh; without the Nam it goes in vain in every way.

The way-ward are born again. Such is the will of God, O Nanak.

0MA7: Sabhu ko = every being. Sabhi = all.

You, O God, belongest to all and all belong to You. My Master, the King, You have created all.
O Hari Ram Raje! You are the Master of all and they are Your servants; all are created by You alone.
72ZN: Hathi = in the hand. Chalahi = they walk, they move.

Nothing is in anyone's hands; all walk as You cause them to walk.
Nothing, nothing is in the hands of any one. All walk as You drivest them.
In no one's hand is any thing at all, not even a little; all move as moved by You.
06NN: Piare = O Beloved! Tudhu = You. Mani = in the mind. Bhae = they seem good.

5G7U: Nami = by way of the Nam. Tarae = carries across ||3||

Servant Nanak has met the True Guru, and through the Lord's Name, he has been carried across. ||3||
Servant Nanak has met the True Guru, who, through God's Name, has floated him.
Sri Guru Ji says: those servants to whom by Your grace the Satigur has been met — O Hari, possessor of the Nam! them You have carried across. ||3||

Some sing Lord God through music, musical instruments and religions books in various ways, but, by these methods, Master, the King is not pleased.

Some persons perform Your singing by (ragi) rags and by nads; some perform it by the chanting of the Ved; but O Hari! In this way they sing much and in many fashions. Without love You are not (bhijai) softened, that is to say You are not pleased.
1XN2: Antari = within. Kapatu = deceit. Roi = having wept.

Those within whose antahkaran is the disease which is deceit — what will they accomplish by false weeping? That is to say, their weeping is false; or, what praise is there in their weeping?

God, the Creator, knows everything, though man tries to hide his sin or source of disease.

Or, He puts the chief disease of pride into the hand which is their mind.
N46V: Sudhu = pure. Gurmukhi = by taking the Guru's shelter ||4||11||18||

ABA2: Bhuli = having erred. Chuki = having stumbled. Bhi = still. Khare = good. Bhane = they seem dear.
If they ever, erring and stumbling, utter (mistaken words) outwardly among people, still they seem good and dear to Parmatma.
Even if they misspeak outwardly, they are still very pleasing to the Lord.
Even if they outwardly err in speech, still they are very dear to God.
Although outwardly they (bhuli chuki) err and stumble in speech, (bhi) even so they have (khare) fully seemed (bhane) good to Hari.
WSN8: Parmatma's sants have no other support (apart from Parmatma); (they know that) Parmatma alone is the honour of the honourless.
The Lord's Saints have no other place. The Lord is the honor of the dishonored.
God's saints have no other place. God is the honour of the dishonoured.
To Hari's sants there is no other place apart from Hari, because the giver of honour to the honourless is Hari alone.
48DL: Dibanu = support, the place of appeal. Tanu = strength, strength of arm. Satane = strong, possessed of strength ||1||
O Nanak! For Parmatma's servants Parmatma's Nam alone is the support; Parmatma alone is their strength of arm, (on the strength of which, against the vices) they stay strong. ||1||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Royal Court for servant Nanak; the Lord's power is his only power. ||1||
The Name is the mainstay of slave Nanak, and through God's power he is powerful.
Sri Guru Ji says: to them the Nam alone is (dibanu) the support, because they, having obtained the (tan) strength of Hari alone, have become (satane) possessed of strength. ||1||
3J14: Jithai = at which place. Jai = having gone. Suhava = beautiful.
That place where the beloved Guru goes and sits becomes (for the Gursikhs) a beautiful place.
Wherever my True Guru goes and sits, that place is beautiful, O Lord King.
Wherever my True Guru goes and sits, beautiful is that place, O Lord, the King.
My Satiguru, who is the form of Ram Raje, wherever he goes and sits in visible form, or in whichever heart he goes and sits in the form of the updesh, that place becomes resplendent.
EQWT: Gursikhi = the Gursikhs have. Bhalia = found. Dhuri = dust. Mukhi = upon the face.
The Gursikhs find that place, and taking its dust they apply it to their own forehead.
The Guru's Sikhs seek out that place; they take the dust and apply it to their faces.
The Guru's disciples search out that site and take and apply the dust there of to there face.
The Gursikhs have searched out that very place, and taking the dust of that place they have applied it to the face.
RBYW: Ghal = labour. Thai pai = became accepted (at Prabhu's door).
Those Gursikhs who remember Parmatma's Nam — their labour (of seeking the Guru's place) is accepted at Parmatma's door.
The works of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord's Name, are approved.
The service of the Guru's Sikhs, who ponder on the Name is approved.
Those who have meditated upon the Hari Nam, the (ghal) service of those Gursikhs has (thai pai) become fruitful.
DCP5: Puj karava = has worship done. Karava = karai. Lava = lai. Dhiava = dhiaia ||2||
Nanak — those men who seat the honour and regard of the Guru (within their own heart), Parmatma has (their) honour done (in the world). ||2||
Those who worship the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord causes them to be worshipped in turn. ||2||
They, who worship the True Guru, them the Lord causes to be worshipped.
Sri Guru Ji says: those who have performed the worship of the Satigurus, Hari has their worship performed by the whole world. ||2||
87M2: Mani = in the mind. Hari = O Hari!
O Hari! In the mind of the Guru's Sikhs Your love stays formed, the love of Your Nam stays settled,
The Guru's Sikh keeps the Love of the Lord, and the Name of the Lord, in his mind. He loves You, O Lord, O Lord King.
The Guru's Sikh, in his mind, has love for God and God's Name. He Loves You, O Lord God, the King.
O Hari Ram Raje! In the mind of the Gursikhs, in every way, for the sake of attaining You, is the love of repeating the Hari Nam.
